notes: Foster-based rat & small-animal rescue covering New England and, on a LIMITED basis, the NYC metro. One of the few rescues specifically oriented to pet RATS (which are otherwise hard to place). Rats are highly social and should be adopted in pairs/groups. Confirm NYC-area capacity before referring; if unavailable, try Sean Casey, Brooklyn Cat Cafe small-animals, ACC, or a local pet-rat Facebook group.
